main module

Main entry point for the Affective Dyna-Q GridWorld simulator.

Loads configuration parameters from .cfg files in settings/, initializes the environment and agent, runs independent multi-seed experiments, and saves visual outputs and metric reports. Supports both single-configuration runs and batch sequential execution of all configurations via –all, with an optional –exclude flag to skip specific configuration files.

main.discover_config_files(target_path: str = 'settings') → List[str]

Recursively discover all .cfg files in target_path, sorted alphabetically.

Parameters:

target_path (str) – File path or directory path.

Returns:

List of sorted .cfg file paths.

Return type:

List[str]

main.is_file_excluded(file_path: str, exclude_patterns: List[str]) → bool

Check if a file path matches any exclusion pattern or explicit file name.

Matches by: - Exact absolute path - Normalized relative path (e.g. ‘settings/default.cfg’) - Filename with extension (e.g. ‘default.cfg’) - Filename without extension (e.g. ‘default’)

Parameters:

  • file_path (str) – Path of configuration file to check.

  • exclude_patterns (List[str]) – List of exclusion strings/paths.

Returns:

True if file should be excluded, False otherwise.

Return type:

bool

main.main() → None

Main execution function.

Parses command-line arguments and launches the simulation in either GUI or headless mode, with support for single file or batch (–all) execution, and optional exclusion (–exclude) of specific configuration files.

CLI Usage:
  • Run with GUI (default for single config):

    python3 main.py settings/nama_file.cfg

  • Run in headless (CLI terminal) mode:

    python3 main.py –headless settings/nama_file.cfg

  • Run all configuration files in settings/ sequentially:

    python3 main.py –all python3 main.py –headless –all

  • Run all configuration files while excluding specific files:

    python3 main.py –all –exclude settings/default.cfg python3 main.py –all -e default.cfg kruskal_static.cfg

  • Run all configuration files in a specific sub-folder:

    python3 main.py –all settings/exponential_decay

  • Default (loads settings/default.cfg in GUI):

    python3 main.py
